name: the-ledger
description: The Fourth Branch / Integrity Project brand palette, a civic public-record aesthetic. Every color is chosen, not inherited: cool paper (not warm cream), verdigris as primary accent (aged bronze/civic monuments), brass reserved for financial figures only, a muted seal-red for status/new markers.

usageRules.verdigris: Primary accent: links, active states, Watch feature, CTAs.
usageRules.brass: Reserved exclusively for financial figures (money-involved fields, price displays). Do not use as a general accent; the point is a consistent 'follow the money' visual thread.
usageRules.seal: Status/new markers only (docket 'New' badges, alert accents). Not a general error/danger color; this is a document-stamp reference, not semantic red.
usageRules.inkBand: Reserved for the Watch section and any 'this changed, pay attention' moment. An inverted band, used sparingly, not a repeating section background.
